## Verification

- [ ] Required clean AirType build passes.
- [ ] Relevant focused tests pass.
- [ ] Full xUnit suite passes when production behavior changed.
- [ ] Local ASR worker tests pass when worker/package behavior changed.
- [ ] No recordings, transcripts, credentials, logs, or private traces are attached.
- [ ] Every commit includes a `Signed-off-by` line under `DCO.txt`.
